orehall.configuration.title: Orehall Configuration
orehall.configuration.reset.tooltip: Reset all options in this section and sub-categories back to their default values.
orehall.configuration.recipe_tweaks.tool: Various recipe modifications, vanilla replacements, and utility recipes.
orehall.configuration.recipe_tweaks.enab: Master switch to enable or disable all features in the Recipe Tweaks module.
orehall.configuration.recipe_tweaks.repl: Crafting recipes that reliably replace vanilla Minecraft recipes when enabled.
Replaces vanilla's shaped recovery compass recipe with a flexible shapeless recipe (Compass + 8 Echo Shards).
Replaces vanilla's single-diagonal shears recipe with an any-diagonal recipe (2 Iron Ingots anywhere in grid).
Replaces vanilla's strict vertical spyglass recipe with a flexible shaped recipe (Amethyst Shard over 2 Copper Ingots).
Replaces vanilla's lever recipe with a recipe requiring redstone dust.
Replaces vanilla's respawn anchor recipe with a reliable crafting recipe (Ender Pearl + Crying Obsidian + Gold Ingots).
orehall.configuration.recipe_tweaks.util: Helpful crafting and convenience recipes added by Orehall.
Enables crafting sugar directly from beetroot in a crafting grid.
Enables crafting a bell using wooden slabs and gold ingots.
orehall.configuration.recipe_tweaks.auto: Dynamic runtime scanning system that finds matching recipes across vanilla and mods and replaces them automatically.
Master switch to enable or disable the entire dynamic recipe replacement system.
List of dynamic recipe replacement rules using the key-value DSL. Default entries configure buttons, pressure plates, doors, trapdoors, fences, fence gates, signs, hanging signs, and chains.
orehall.configuration.gameplay_tweaks.to: Tweaks and adjustments to core gameplay mechanics.
orehall.configuration.gameplay_tweaks.en: Master switch to enable or disable all features in the Gameplay Tweaks module.
orehall.configuration.gameplay_tweaks.du: When enabled, custom durability adjustments from 'config/orehall/durability.toml' are applied upon startup.
When enabled, newly installed mod items are automatically discovered and added to 'config/orehall/durability.toml'.
List of item IDs, tags (starting with '#'), or wildcard patterns that will be made completely unbreakable.
When enabled, items made unbreakable display the 'Unbreakable' line in their tooltip.
orehall.configuration.gameplay_tweaks.mo: Tweaks and adjustments to vanilla mobs and creatures.
Master switch to enable or disable all mob tweaks.
Enable or disable tweaks applied to goats.
When enabled, goats drop 1-2 mutton when killed (cooked if killed while on fire), exactly like sheep.
When enabled, milking goats triggers a cooldown before they can be milked again.
Milking cooldown duration in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second, 6000 ticks = 5 minutes). Set to 0 to disable cooldown.
When enabled, feeding goats wheat clears their milking cooldown.
Enable or disable tweaks applied to cows.
When enabled, milking cows triggers a cooldown before they can be milked again.
Milking cooldown duration in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second, 1200 ticks = 1 minute). Set to 0 to disable cooldown.
When enabled, feeding cows wheat clears their milking cooldown.
Enable or disable tweaks applied to mooshrooms.
When enabled, milking mooshrooms with a bucket triggers a cooldown before they can be milked again.
Milking cooldown duration in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second, 1200 ticks = 1 minute). Set to 0 to disable cooldown.
When enabled, harvesting stew from mooshrooms with a bowl triggers a cooldown before they can be milked for stew again.
Stew milking cooldown duration in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second, 1200 ticks = 1 minute). Set to 0 to disable cooldown.
When enabled, feeding mooshrooms wheat clears their milking and stew cooldowns.
orehall.configuration.gameplay_tweaks.it: Tweaks and adjustments to items and equipment.
Master switch to enable or disable all item tweaks.
Tweaks specific to the recovery compass.
Enable or disable tweaks applied to the recovery compass.
When enabled, recovery compasses persist through death, avoiding drops and gravestone storage.
When enabled, holding Shift while hovering over a recovery compass displays the coordinates and dimension of your last death.
When enabled, right-clicking with a recovery compass in hand displays your last death coordinates above the hotbar.
orehall.configuration.gameplay_tweaks.sl: Tweaks and adjustments to sleeping and beds.
Master switch to enable or disable all sleeping tweaks.
When enabled, sleeping in or using beds does not set or override your respawn point. Forced spawn points and respawn anchors remain unaffected.
Tweaks and adjustments to the respawn anchor block, fuel items, and dimension compatibility.
Master switch to enable or disable all respawn anchor tweaks.

Item or tag used as fuel for the respawn anchor. Default: 'minecraft:echo_shard'. If empty or invalid, defaults to 'minecraft:glowstone'. When set to another item, glowstone is no longer accepted as fuel.
A comma-separated list of dimension IDs where the respawn anchor will not work and will explode upon interaction. Leave empty to allow in all dimensions (including Overworld and End).
